invariants.rationale: partitionPath is likely a non-null string encoding a partition, which is essential for identification.
fileId uniquely identifies the file to update; it being null would likely be an error.
The iterator of HoodieRecord<T> is required for update processing and should not be null.
partitionPath should not be an empty string; it must refer to some valid partition.
fileId should have a non-empty value to uniquely identify a file for update.
